name: openclaude-antigravity-provider
description: Local OpenAI-compatible proxy that authenticates via Google Antigravity OAuth, enabling OpenClaude to use Claude Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.6, and Gemini 3 Pro/Flash with your Google credentials.

plugins.name: openclaude-antigravity-provider
plugins.description: Auto-starting local proxy bridge: Google Antigravity OAuth with OpenAI-compatible API surface for OpenClaude. Multi-account rotation, automatic token refresh, rate-limit fallback.
